description: A server is measured against the capabilities it advertises at GET /spec, not against this project's numbers. Advertising something that is not enforced is the failure these cases catch: a client that trusts the declaration is the one that gets hurt.

cases.description: A cell larger than the advertised maximum is refused, and one comfortably below it is accepted.
lifecycle_scheduler.manual_run_endpoint names a route the server actually serves, rather than one it merely mentions.
The version reported by /spec and by /health is the same. Two answers to one question is how a deployment starts lying about itself.
